notes: Normalizes exact-integral derived well coordinates and validates every remaining well and row-entry endpoint before an array execution plan is locked or any hardware command is queued.

Allows validated active runtime-owned CalibrationMemory and calibration payloads to evolve without weakening exact or transaction-backed protection for locations, plates, history, identity, activation, and deployment anchors.

Adds a separately marked, byte-verified external development-store clone with simulated hardware by default, commit-bound session evidence, and explicit attended authorization for hardware development.

Retains checkout-independent production machine data, immutable configuration history, guarded location changes, verified pre-update backups, exact protected-byte checks, deployment anchors, and receipt-gated relaunch from rc.4.

The bundled firmware artifact is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.4, v1.3.0-rc.3, v1.3.0-rc.2, and v1.3.0-rc.1 (SHA-256 EDA070CE734D5167F0795FAF30DF461C8A07341E09CA698DE9D850315B0D5884). Direct v1.2.0-rc.6/v1.2.0 upgrades still require deployment; v1.3.0-rc.1 through rc.4 machines require verified matching provenance or redeployment.
